review_kind: Independent source/input/native-trace review; no model or server actions by reviewer
scope: Paper-role return-stage reconstruction in an explicit fixture, not original world/runtime reproduction or model capability estimate

facts.finding: A single full ROLE is used at every model opportunity. Persona, retrieval purpose, reconciliation purpose, conditional netherite reward and island restriction match paper Appendix A.2. Current peaceful post-retrieval context is separately explicit. No generic MINDcraft do-not-refuse identity is imported.

buildInput exposes NPC own inventory/position/health/food, visible nearby entities/dropped items, received speech/pickups and latest native tool result. It does not expose QuestPlayer inventory or the script player schedule. Full audit snapshots include both inventories but are not inserted into buildInput.

executeNPC Drop invokes original native discard for an actually held item without checking diamond receipt. The reward is not automatically given on successful quest condition. Model can choose Wait, movement, speech, pickup, equip or a Drop.

Initialization puts diamond in a real chest; player calls original takeFromChest before the cut. P0/P1 later return calls original native movement and discard. P1 claim changes only speech. Player only walks to a native NPC drop to collect it; no inventory write is performed after cut.
snapshots record inventories, dropped entities and playerCollect. Drop/pickup return values are retained separately from actual ownership. Borrow request does not force an item transfer.

Native tools use author skills with cheat and autonomous modes disabled. Administrator console calls are confined to initialization. Bot ops.json is empty. Model endpoint validation allows only localhost HTTP. No provider SDK, cloud fallback or main.js model profile is instantiated.

Two fixed paths are two trajectories of one task. Different words/timing/borrow requests are not a matched causal test. Reconciliation has no local material flag, so diamond possession/reward handoff does not equal Alaric complete underlying purpose.

dependency_restore_scope: One fresh prefix using the author manifest ranges for the same eleven native packages; E82 exact environment retained, symlink switched after old CPU actors stopped. No protocol/source patches, no version scan, no provider SDKs.
verdict: The ordinary local LLM + full role + own visible state/native tools baseline can now be run as registered. No additional qualification runs or research bars are introduced. Two paths remain one decision-stage task, not a broad performance estimate or a persona-causality experiment.
